preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The target points k must be between 0 and 100,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(sequence) == n and len(set(sequence)) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in sequence) and sum(gcd(sequence[i], sequence[i+1]) for i in range(0, len(sequence)-1, 2)) == k)
postconditions.description: The output must be either '-1' if no valid sequence exists, or a sequence of n distinct integers each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive, such that the sum of the gcd of each pair of consecutively removed numbers equals k.
